assistants.title: Your assistants
assistants.intro: Create focused AI assistants grounded in your company documents. Each assistant has its own knowledge base and conversation history.
assistants.emptyState: You don't have any assistants yet.
assistants.emptyStateAction: Create your first assistant to get started.

createModal.title: Create an assistant
createModal.subtitle: Give your assistant a name and connect your model provider.
createModal.slugHelp: Used in the assistant’s URL. Use lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens.
createModal.keyHelp: Your key is encrypted on the server and never exposed in the browser.

knowledge.intro: Manage the documents this assistant can use to answer questions. Only content in this knowledge base can support its answers.
knowledge.uploadSubtitle: PDF, DOCX or TXT · Add the approved information this assistant should rely on.

chat.groundedNotice: Answers grounded in its knowledge base
chat.welcomeTitle: What would you like to know?
chat.welcomeSubtitle: Ask a question about your company documents. Answers should include sources so you can verify the information.
chat.suggestion1: How many vacation days do employees get?
chat.suggestion2: What should a new hire do on day one?
chat.suggestion3: How do I enroll in health benefits?
chat.suggestion4: What is the remote work policy?
chat.disclaimer: ManualMind can make mistakes. Check the cited source before relying on an answer.

auth.signInSubtitle: Private AI assistants grounded in your verified documents.
auth.tagline: Enterprise-grade RAG with real citations and zero hallucination tolerance.
